plan.headline: #1 Wood Elf Catcher — move
steps: 1. Dodge from L2 to K1: D6 needs 2+ → 83.3%, 97.2% with Dodge
probabilities: Completes as planned: 97.2% without Team Re-rolls
Not computed: 6.8e-6% of outcomes (very long bounce chains)
assumptions: Re-rolls: a failed roll is re-rolled with a skill first (Dodge, Sure Feet, Sure Hands, Catch, Pass), then Pro, then a Team/Leader Re-roll (when that column allows team re-rolls). You still choose every re-roll during execution.

Block dice: the choosing coach takes the result that is best for them (knock-down without falling > push > nothing > both down > player down), taking Block, Dodge, Tackle, Wrestle and Juggernaut into account. The attacker re-rolls block dice only when every result is bad for them.
Pushes: the first listed push square is assumed (you pick the real one during execution). The defender uses Stand Firm, Fend and Sidestep; Taunt is not used.
